q: Write the formula of potassium chloride.
Write the formula of calcium chloride.
CaCl₂: two Cl⁻ balance one Ca²⁺.
Write the formulae of aluminium oxide and magnesium nitride.
Explain why the formula of an ionic compound has no overall charge.
The positive and negative charges must cancel: the compound is neutral, so ions combine in the ratio that balances them.
